messages:
mona: PR #10488 updates the 'migration/hosts' guide and includes an example that looks like a real KMS token. CI preview also flagged a dead anchor. Need security + legal quick thumbs; want to merge in the 2pm docs slot.

ci-bot: Docs preview for PR 10488: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/10488 — build: passed, link-check: failed (1 broken anchor). Files changed: docs/migration/hosts.md

diego: I can replace the literal token with a clear placeholder and add a one-line Secret Manager example. Should we use REPLACED_SECRET or PLACEHOLDER_SECRET?

sec-bot: Policy: do not include realistic token prefixes. Use PLACEHOLDER_SECRET or show secret-manager usage. Opening sec-250 to track.

mona: Original snippet (bad):
```bash
# BAD: looks real
HOST_KMS=host_live_7fa2e1b3c
```

mona: Replacement I'm pushing in branch 10488-clean:
```js
// GOOD: load from Secret Manager or CI env
const hostKey = await secretManager.access('projects/x/secrets/HOST_KMS/versions/latest');
// or const hostKey = process.env.HOST_KMS // injected by CI
```

diego: I also fixed the bad anchor that CI found and updated the contributor guide link.

legal-bot: Legal note: avoid showing common prefixes like host_live_ or sk_; if you must show a sample string use GENERIC_KEY or PLACEHOLDER_SECRET. No legal objections otherwise.

harper: Added a 1-line callout at the top of the doc: "Do not paste real keys in docs; use Secret Manager or CI-injected env vars." Also added a changelog entry.

ci-bot: Preview updated: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/10488 — build: succeeded, link-check: passed.

sec-bot: Sec-250 reviewed, security approves the replacement. Will close after merge.

mona: Planning to merge at 2:05pm PT in the docs merge window. Please flag if you need a different time.

diego: Fine by me. I'll monitor the merge.

legal-bot: Approved.

mona: Merged at 2:06pm PT. Closing sec-250 and filing a tiny follow-up to add these placeholder rules to the contributor checklist. Thanks everyone!
